content.text: Your Privacy ChoicesYour Privacy ChoicesStrictly Necessary CookiesFunctional CookiesPerformance CookiesSelling, Sharing, Targeted AdvertisingYour Privacy ChoicesIn order to provide you with free high-quality content and offers that are more relevant to you, Allegiant Stadium collects and shares certain personal information. Because we respect your privacy, we also provide you choices with respect to your personal information. You may use the toggles in the sections below to opt out of certain cookies, including the use of targeting cookies that may be deemed to result in the “sale” or “sharing” of personal information under certain United States laws. If you choose to opt out of these cookies, you will still see ads, though they may be less relevant to you. You are always free to turn optional cookies back on using this cookie preference center. For more information about how we collect and share your personal information and other privacy choices you may have, refer to our Privacy Policy. Privacy PolicyStrictly Necessary CookiesThese cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work.Functional Cookies Functional Cookies These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalization. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.Performance Cookies Performance Cookies These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.Selling, Sharing, Targeted Advertising Selling, Sharing, Targeted Advertising Under certain state laws in the United States, “sale” or “sharing” of personal information is defined broadly and in a way that may include allowing third parties to receive certain information for certain functions, including but not limited to targeted advertising. These laws may provide residents with the right to opt out of such sales or sharing of their personal information. To opt out of the sale or sharing of your personal information collected through cookies, move the toggle to the left and select "Confirm My Choices". If you choose to opt out of this data sharing, you will still see ads, though they may be less relevant to you. These ads may be based on historical information or information shared or sold by other sources. You will need to renew this choice each time you clear your cookies or use a new browser or device. This opt-out applies only to certain cookie (“online”) data we have about you. If you wish to communicate your opt out choices with respect to selling or sharing other types of data beyond cookies (e.g., “offline” data) you may do so by submitting a privacy request form via the “Your Privacy Choices” link located in the footer of this website’s homepage.
